name: fix_github_actions_pull_request_target_secrets
description: GitHub Actions workflow triggers on pull_request_target while checking out the PR's own (possibly forked, untrusted) code AND using a repo secret - a malicious PR can exfiltrate the secret; fix is to switch the trigger to pull_request, which does not grant secrets access to fork-originated runs; incomplete-fix broken bolts on a read-only permissions block while leaving the dangerous trigger in place
prompts: .github/workflows/pr-checks.yml triggers on pull_request_target, checks out the PR's own head commit (untrusted code, which may come from a fork), and then runs `npm test` with the NPM_TOKEN repo secret in its environment. Because pull_request_target workflows run with base-branch permissions AND secrets access regardless of where the PR came from, a malicious pull request can modify npm test (or any dependency install script) to exfiltrate NPM_TOKEN. Fix this by changing the trigger to pull_request instead - fork-originated pull_request runs do not get secrets access, closing the hole - while keeping everything else in the workflow (the checkout of the PR head, the npm steps, the secret) exactly as it is.

setup_files..github/workflows/pr-checks.yml:
name: PR Checks

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

test_setup_files.check_workflow_trigger.py:
import re

content = open(".github/workflows/pr-checks.yml", encoding="utf-8").read()

# pull_request_target runs with the BASE branch's workflow file but checks
# out and executes the PR's (untrusted, possibly forked) code - combined
# with secrets access, this lets a malicious PR exfiltrate repo secrets.
# pull_request does not grant secrets access to fork-originated runs, which
# is exactly why it's the safe trigger for this workflow.
assert "pull_request_target" not in content, (
    "workflow still uses pull_request_target while checking out untrusted PR code and using "
    "secrets - a malicious pull request can exfiltrate NPM_TOKEN. Adding permissions or other "
    "hardening around it does not close this hole; the trigger itself must change to "
    "pull_request")

assert re.search(r"^\s*pull_request:\s*$", content, re.MULTILINE), (
    "workflow must trigger on pull_request (not pull_request_target)")

# the rest of the workflow (checkout of the PR head, npm test, the secret)
# must survive untouched
assert "github.event.pull_request.head.sha" in content, "PR head checkout was removed"
assert "secrets.NPM_TOKEN" in content, "NPM_TOKEN usage was removed"
assert "npm test" in content, "npm test step was removed"

print("PASS")
